profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software engineering is what I do and I love what I do!  Which goes a long way towards being successful.

Being a functional, caring, empowered part of a team allows me to achieving heights that as an individual could never imagine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft Teams
- iOS (Swift + Objective C)
- Services (.NET)
- Desktop/Web (Angular, React)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skype Converged Core Engineering
 - React
 - React Native
 - Type-script
 - Android/Java
 - Messaging UI

positions.title: Development Manager/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I collaborated with a small group of software engineers to design, write, test, and distribute commercial software.  

Tools and skills utilized: Visual Studio, C#, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, Delphi (object pascal), C++, Firebird Database Engine, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL Server, InstallShield, Bugzilla, and WiX to name a few.

I'm was also responsible for the implementation and maintenance of our LAN, WLAN, WAN, Web Servers (internal and external), File Servers, Email Server (Exchange Server), Active Directory, and Cisco Firewall and Router.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote, designed, supported, and tested image processing software in C#, Delphi, MS Access, and MS SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Software Technician
positions.description:
Supported mission critical production system.

Developed, maintained, and supported HMI Software Interfaces in Delphi and C++ using Firebird/Interbase, Paradox, dBase, and MS SQL Server as back-end data providers.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Software Design and Engineering and IT (network) infrastructural design and engineering
